name: Media Stream AI Jamaica AI data center
developer: Media Stream AI / Government of Jamaica
notes: DCD reported Media Stream AI had completed an agreement with the Government of Jamaica to build and operate the country's first AI data center; exact Jamaica parish/site was not disclosed. Assigned to Kingston for batch coverage because Jamaica operations/government AI activity surfaced in Kingston searches; treat division as uncertain.

name: eGov Data Centre / Government Data Centre upgrade
developer: eGov Jamaica Limited / Transformation Implementation Unit
notes: J$600m upgrade begun in 2020 and reported completed/near-complete in 2024; sources describe Tier-II compliant government data center with colocation services at 235B/6 Old Hope Road, Kingston 6, Saint Andrew. Storage capacity rose from 615 TB to 1,300 TB; MW capacity not reported.

name: Digicel Caymanas Data Centre
notes: Tier III certified colocation/data centre in Caymanas/Central Village, St. Catherine Parish. Jamaica Observer reported J$600m investment and Uptime certification; Uptime Institute lists project location as St. Catherine Parish.

name: eGov Disaster Recovery site at Digicel Caymanas
notes: Government/eGov data centre upgrade included physical-plant renovation, automated management tools, and security components at both the eGov primary data center and its disaster recovery site in St. Catherine; JIS/Our Today identify the DR site as Digicel Caymanas.
